design.decision: Once your contract is safe, keep winning tricks to set the opponents rather than ducking.
design.opponent: Revealed at scoring; opponents learn that a marginal bid is riskier against this team.
design.rationale: Gives low-contract Nil teams a defensive plan and makes overtricks worth chasing without bags.
design.draftText: +15 contract multiplier if the opponents miss their contract
